entry.title: TinyFreaky 0.4.1
entry.summary: Reduces display work by limiting mascot updates to 30 Hz and sending visual notifications only when values change. Audio binary unchanged from the CPU-tested build; package metadata now uses 0.4.1. Local before/after audio comparisons were bit-identical across the 16 engines and 342 playable factory sounds. Installation and application restart checked on Force 3.9.1. Full firmware 3.10, MPC hardware and Q-Link automation validation remain pending; no measured hardware CPU percentage is claimed.

entry.title: TinyFreaky 0.4.0
entry.summary: TinyFreaky by MagicStino brings expressive **eight-voice synthesis** to Akai Force and MPC via OpenPlugin, plus Windows, macOS and Linux. ### Explore the sound 16 engines span detuned waves, wavetable and additive textures, plucked strings, virtual analog, waveshaping, FM, formants, chords, speech, modal resonance, noise and bass.
